semiconductor_relevance: High — KOVIS Technology specializes in metrology and handling equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: KOVIS Technology Co., Ltd is a manufacturer of advanced handler and metrology equipment, focusing on wafer surface inspection and micro bump measurement. Their products utilize high-performance metrology tools integrated with fully-automatic wafer handling robot technology, aiming to enhance efficiency and precision in semiconductor production.
